keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Aurélien Tchouaméni (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Real Madrid 0, PSV Eindhoven 1. Ivan Perisic (PSV Eindhoven) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Filip Kostic (PSV Eindhoven) is shown the yellow card.
Antonio Rüdiger (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Real Madrid 0, PSV Eindhoven 1.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Ibrahima Konaté replaces Antonio Rüdiger.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Jude Bellingham replaces Aurélien Tchouaméni.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Dean Huijsen replaces Éder Militão.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Esmir Bajraktarevic replaces Ivan Perisic.
Second Half begins Real Madrid 0, PSV Eindhoven 1.
Goal! Real Madrid 1, PSV Eindhoven 1. Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Arda Güler.
Goal! Real Madrid 2, PSV Eindhoven 1. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kylian Mbappé.
Goal! Real Madrid 3, PSV Eindhoven 1. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Arda Güler.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Noah Fernandez replaces Paul Wanner.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Yarek Gasiorowski replaces Filip Kostic.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Eduardo Camavinga replaces Arda Güler.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Ryan Flamingo replaces Kodai Sano.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Brahim Díaz replaces Yan Diomande.
Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Ayoni Santos replaces Ruben van Bommel.
Goal! Real Madrid 4, PSV Eindhoven 1. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Brahim Díaz with a through ball.
Goal! Real Madrid 5, PSV Eindhoven 1. Vinícius Júnior (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jude Bellingham following a fast break.
Second Half ends, Real Madrid 5, PSV Eindhoven 1.
